description_en: Modifies the name of a node in a PolarDB cluster
kebab_example: aliyun polardb modify-db-node-description --db-cluster-id pc-000000000000000 --db-node-description NodeDescriptionTest --db-node-id pi-00000000000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBNodeDescription

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the cluster.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html operation to view information about all clusters in the destination region, including cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html接口查看目标地域下的所有集群信息，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the node. The name must meet the following requirements:

It cannot start with http\:// or https\://.

It must be 2 to 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
节点名称，需满足如下要求：
不能以http://或https://开头。
长度为 2~256 个字符
parameters.name: db_node_description

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the cluster node.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/185342.html operation to view the details of all clusters that belong to your account, including node IDs
parameters.help_zh:
集群节点ID。
您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/185342.html接口查看账号下所有集群的详细信息，包括节点ID
parameters.name: db_node_id
